title: How much power can a single turbine generate?

segments.text: How much power can a single turbine generate?
Steam turbines drive generators in fossil, nuclear, geothermal, and solar‑thermal plants and supplied about 42% of U.S. electricity in 2022.
The largest built unit, the 1,770 MW Arabelle turbine, will power Hinkley Point C in England.
Modern steam turbines are built from high‑grade steel alloys using advanced metalworking techniques that became available in the 20th century.
Their design uses multiple stages to expand steam efficiently, making such a single turbine capable of delivering megawatt‑scale electricity output.
